indicator: Heroin seized by Douane (kg and number of seizures)
bias_limitations: Single large seizures dominate the kg series; the jump in the number of seizures from 2021 points to many small consignments. Enforcement-driven; seizures at the border may include heroin in transit.

indicator: OM investigations into cocaine and heroin
drug_specific: No (cocaine and heroin together; cocaine dominates)
bias_limitations: Not separable from cocaine; the rise most likely reflects the cocaine trade.

indicator: Perceived drug use / dealing nuisance in neighbourhood
bias_limitations: Not drug-specific. Street-scene heroin use is a known source of nuisance, but this series cannot attribute nuisance to heroin.

indicator: Property crime by dependent users (e.g. ISD placements of persistent offenders)
bias_limitations: The classic crime harm of heroin. No series links offenders to heroin; ISD and persistent-offender figures could serve as a proxy.
Too rare for a population survey: last-year values are rounded to 0 or 0.1, and the marginalised users who matter most are missed. CBS does not publish heroin in its Leefstijlmonitor tables.

indicator: Opioid painkillers used (also) without prescription, adults 18+, last year
bias_limitations: Three points; self-report of non-prescribed use.

indicator: Estimated number of high-risk opioid users (street scene, incl. people on methadone)
source: Trimbos OPAAK study 2023; earlier estimate 2012 (via NDM)
bias_limitations: Two points; the NDM warns the estimates are not one-to-one comparable (method and recruitment differ). 89% of the 2023 group also used crack.

indicator: Lifetime heroin use among mbo and hbo students 16–18
bias_limitations: Three points, no recent data; not plotted.

indicator: Clients in addiction care with opioids as primary or secondary problem
bias_limitations: An ageing cohort in long-term care: falling numbers reflect mortality and ageing as much as less harm. Painkiller problems are not separately recorded; about 85–90% of institutions report.

indicator: General-hospital admissions with an opioid diagnosis (main or secondary), excl. and incl. synthetic opioids
drug_specific: Partly (opioids; 'excl. synthetic' is closer to heroin)
bias_limitations: Coding practice; the 'excl. synthetic' series still includes morphine and methadone poisonings, and early values look rounded to 5 or 10.

indicator: Share of drug incidents involving heroin/methadone
bias_limitations: No yearly series published per drug for opioids; candidate for a data request.

indicator: Drug deaths involving opioids (EUDA definition); deaths with F11 as underlying cause
bias_limitations: Of the 161 opioid deaths in 2024, 112 were 'other opioids' (painkillers such as oxycodone and morphine) and only a small part heroin or methadone; about one in three was suicide. Not a heroin series.

indicator: New HIV and hepatitis infections among people who use drugs by injection
bias_limitations: Injecting is now rare in the Netherlands; most infections date from the past.
Very few samples (114 in 2025, many collected by field workers since 2024); earlier years not comparable.
Medical use, not harm in itself; included because medicinal opioids make up most opioid deaths (r = .81 with opioid deaths, n = 11).

indicator: Nitazenes and other new synthetic opioids (alerts, NVIC enquiries)
bias_limitations: Early-warning signal, not a harm count.
